description.fallback: Messina wakes Joseph up at 5:00 pm to tell him they have caught up to the mail train. Joseph starts to get out of the car to break into the train, but another car comes up behind Lisa Lisa's and the driver honks at them. Joseph looks back at the car, wondering why it doesn't just pass them since there is plenty of room to on the road, but then he notices that Nazis are driving the car.
